order_exercise.command_budget: Maximum four ordinary commands per drive: at most enqueue+immediate cancellation, and two activity commands. The once-only bootstrap separately queues up to six ordinary paid build orders. No missed-deadline catch-up dump.
explicit_limits: This is observed coverage, not a guarantee every order completes or every emergent trait occurs.
Sanctuary is not an implemented separate building: the supported equivalent is Pen plus handlers, care, research, breeding, release and habitat protection.
No paid demolition command exists; dam breach/destruction must come from actual opposing weapons or ecological physical events.
Production20km streaming and the remaining130traits are not implemented by this small-map test.
Naval faction1 launch uses the ordinary core paid transaction because there is no faction1 player UI.
Dedicated invariant/mechanism fixtures remain separately labelled from this ordinary long run.

finite_materials.ownership_note: Reserved job materials remain owned exactly once by their job; a worker reference or delivered flag does not create another copy. Ore cargo and cancellation recovery crates are separate finite stocks.

metric_scope.controller: Declared omniscient test-harness placement and both-faction core orders; production player UI and ConservationDriver capture/release remain recon-filtered.
metric_scope.queues: Completion evidence means queue ended after observed physical departure and return to its final waypoint. Cancellations without this physical evidence only count as ended.
metric_scope.satellite: Active samples at the10second observation cadence, not a distinct pass count.
metric_scope.water: Canonical PLAYER fixture-dam flag. Upstream means the first81managedriverrows, not upstream of every animal dam; natural dam/physical counters are reported separately by Campaign.physical.

order_exercise.resume_contract: Serialize OrderExercise with Campaign; restoring only one is an invalid checkpoint.
